item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud las byang dbang drag srid gsum zil gnon
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan lcags phag lo'izla tshes la ka ke'u seng ge yong rdzong nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs/ brag rin chen spungs 'dra mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug du khrom gter spyan drangs te/ slar sa skyongs (skyong) mi dbang dam pa bsod nams can gyi pho brang chen po'i drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi yang rtse ru 'phral du shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba'o/ de yang bstan pa rin po che mi nub gsal ba'i 'od po che phyogs bcur khyab par gyur cig/
